detail: Typed BFS traversal follows specific relation types (decided_by, affects, depends_on, etc.) with depth-based path scoring and relation type bonuses. Adaptive weight fallback redistributes the 35% graph weight proportionally when all graph scores are 0, preventing score compression for sparse/empty graphs. Relevance paths annotate assembled decisions with how they were found.
summary: Replace computeGraphConnectivity with computeGraphReachability using typed BFS and adaptive weight fallback
